headline: Urgent Cold-Chain Insulin Reallocation to District Hospital 2
explanation: District Hospital 1 has 50 vials of Insulin Regular expiring on 2026-11-20 with a daily consumption of 0.5 vials, leaving 40 vials at risk of expiration. District Hospital 2 faces an immediate shortage of 30 vials under current surge conditions. Transferring 28 vials preserves an essential 10-vial reserve at H1 and satisfies 93% of H2's immediate deficit prior to expiration.
